key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the usage endpoint is polled while the session is running.

key.name: panel-metric
key.summary: Which meter to show in the panel
key.description: auto shows the most constrained window. A specific meter can also be pinned.

key.name: show-percentage
key.summary: Show the percentage next to the panel gauge

key.name: notify-rate-limit
key.summary: Notify when a meter is rate-limited

key.name: credentials-revision
key.summary: Internal revision bumped when the stored API key changes
key.description: The extension watches this value to drop caches and reload the key.

key.name: auto-import-key
key.summary: Automatically import the active OpenCode Go key
key.description: When the keyring is empty, read the active Go credential from the local opencode CLI and save it to the keyring.

key.name: endpoint
key.description: Advanced override for the OpenCode Go usage endpoint. Leave at the default unless using a compatible proxy.
